parsed.summary: Router r1 is configured with two Ethernet interfaces, eth1 and eth2. Eth1 connects to a client segment (10.0.1.0/24) while eth2 links to another router (r2) for reaching remote segments (10.0.2.0/24, 10.0.99.0/24, and 10.0.3.0/24 via r2's IP address 10.0.12.2). It also has an iptables rule to drop traffic from the client segment (10.0.1.0/24) destined for 10.0.99.0/24.

static_routes.purpose: Reach the far-side segment via r2
Reach another remote segment via r2
Reach yet another remote segment via r2

access_rules.purpose: Drop traffic from client segment destined for 10.0.99.0/24
